content:
As Taylor Swift rightly said, "I gave my blood, sweat and tears for this." Tbh, mostly tears, like bawling in my room at 2am tears :)
But ig it all came through finally. All the years and months of hardwork has culminated into this single moment for me. It pleases me immensely to announce that I have transitioned into the role of an Associate at Grant Thornton Bharat LLP after a rigorous 6 months Traineeship.
To put it plainly, it was not easy. Stepping into a corporate environment for the first time while facing crucial deadlines felt daunting. (I might have thought about giving up maybe once or twice.) Ok I thought about giving up almost every other week, but ykw, I didn't. I did what I had learnt at my law school. Showing up. I kept my head down, learnt relentlessly from my brilliant peers and seniors and showed up. Every single day. Even if I wanted to leave the office by the time lunch rolled around. And this persistence has certainly paid off.
To top this off, I also passed the All India Bar Examination on my first attempt and enrolled myself as an Advocate at the Bar Council of Delhi and I graduated my B.A., LL.B. from Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies with a first division and a CGPA of 8.62.
Obviously none of this has happened in a vacuum. Everything that I am and everything that I'll ever be is thanks to all these amazing people that I have in my life. A huge thank you to my professors for shaping my legal foundation, my peers and seniors at GT for guiding me always and answering my hundred thousand questions, my friends for always being ready to listen to my rants and definitely my family for never giving up on me. I owe everything to you all.
Although I'm fully aware that I'm still learning and there are miles to go before I sleep, this sounds like a pretty solid start to me.
Here's to everything that is to come!!
